meta.method: PFF-free (CFBD + nflverse). SCORE = production ranking (validated out-of-sample). MAKE-IT = calibrated P(real NFL contributor), pace-adjusted + recruiting pedigree. Not a yardage prediction.

QB.blurb: P(5,000+yd NFL starter). PPA (per-play value) and rushing separate future starters far more than raw passing volume.

WR.blurb: P(3,000+yd NFL receiver). Yards and per-play value lead; extra receptions for the same yards signal a possession role.

RB.blurb: P(2,000+yd NFL rusher). Receiving production predicts NFL success as much as rushing — the most workload-driven board.

TE.blurb: P(1,500+yd NFL tight end). The hardest position to project from box score alone — treat with the most caution.

EDGE.blurb: P(1,500+ NFL defensive snaps). Pass-rush production (sacks, TFL, hurries) and recruiting pedigree lead — pedigree predicts the edge better than college sacks.

IDL.blurb: P(1,500+ NFL defensive snaps). Interior disruption (TFL, sacks, hurries) plus pedigree; pure tackle volume says little.

LB.blurb: P(1,500+ NFL defensive snaps). Playmaking (TFL) and coverage (PD) beat raw tackle counts.

DB.blurb: P(1,500+ NFL defensive snaps). Coverage (PD, INT) outranks tackles — a corner isn't paid to tackle.
